notes.title: Cat Got Your Tongue is coming for you on May 1st!
notes.content:
[b]Cat Got Your Tongue[/b] is a horror point-and-click game where you must escape from the Cat by exploring the darkest corners of the house.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930140/Cat_Got_Your_Tongue/
[h2]Cat Got Your Tongue is coming for you on May 1st![/h2]
And while other companies are looking for employees, I'm looking for buyers. (blink)

You? [i]You[/i]? Or maybe [b]YOU[/b] can already add the game to your wishlist (it will be interesting to see how many of you). So, let's give the game a warm welcome into the indie horror family.

And to add a little extra heat, [b]you'll get a 30% discount[/b] on release! The discount will last [i]two weeks[/i], so don't miss out.

All monster-cat enthusiasts are welcome in the game's credits [u]this July[/u]. [i]Small rewards are also expected[/i]. (heart)
